issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Cobalt Pacific Metals LLC presents a single-source sub-tier dependency risk with USD 1,715,795 in annual spend and 11 sub-tier suppliers, one of which constitutes a critical bottleneck. Despite a moderate resiliency score of 70 and 1 disruption event in the past 12 months, the concentration risk in the sub-tier supply chain threatens continuity for our USD 1.7M spend category.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping workshop with Cobalt Pacific Metals LLC to identify the single-source sub-tier supplier, quantify volume dependency, and assess switching costs
Issue RFI to 3-5 alternative sub-tier suppliers in North America capable of serving the identified material/component, including technical qualification requirements
Negotiate contractual terms with Cobalt Pacific Metals LLC requiring dual-source commitment at sub-tier level with 60/40 volume split and quarterly attestation of sub-tier diversification
Qualify and onboard backup sub-tier supplier through Cobalt Pacific or establish direct relationship if Cobalt Pacific cannot diversify, including quality audits and sample production runs
Implement sub-tier monitoring in risk platform with monthly reporting on source allocation and inventory buffers for critical components

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating single-source sub-tier risk protects USD 1,715,795 in annual spend from potential disruption and reduces estimated exposure cost of 15-25% (USD 257,369 to USD 428,949) in expedite fees and production delays.
kpis: Sub-tier diversification: achieve <70% volume concentration with primary sub-tier supplier within 6 months
Supply continuity: zero unplanned disruptions attributable to sub-tier single-source over next 12 months
Resiliency score improvement: increase from 70 to 80+ within 9 months
Alternate sub-tier qualification: minimum 1 qualified backup supplier by month 5
risks: Cobalt Pacific Metals may resist sub-tier disclosure due to competitive concerns or lack contractual leverage over their suppliers
Alternative sub-tier qualification timeline may extend beyond 18 weeks if technical specifications are proprietary or require extensive testing
Cost increase of 5-12% possible if alternate sub-tier suppliers have less favorable pricing than incumbent single source
Disruption during transition if primary sub-tier supplier reduces commitment in response to volume reallocation
erp_actions: SAP: Add info record note (EINE-INFNR) flagging sub-tier concentration risk for all Cobalt Pacific Metals LLC materials with mandatory buyer approval for POs >USD 50K
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) requiring split between Cobalt Pacific primary and alternate once qualified, with quota arrangement 60/40
Coupa: Enable sub-tier risk monitoring module and configure alert threshold for >70% sub-tier concentration on supplier risk profile
Oracle EBS: Update supplier site (PO_VENDOR_SITES_ALL) attribute DFF to flag 'Sub-Tier Risk - Dual Source Required' for approval workflow routing
All ERPs: Establish safety stock parameter increase of 30 days for items sourced through Cobalt Pacific until sub-tier diversification confirmed (Q1 2027)
